status: PROVISIONAL — field capture schemas for voice extraction and completeness. Validate against client templates and current guidance before production use.

forms.title: BNG condition assessment
forms.description: Habitat type, area, condition criteria, and evidence.
forms.methodology: Statutory Biodiversity Metric condition assessments (Natural England). Per-parcel UKHab typing, area, and Good/Moderate/Poor via habitat-specific criteria.

sections.label: Parcel
sections.description: Ground-truth the desk-study parcel or name a new habitat unit.

fields.label: Parcel reference
fields.voiceHint: Say the parcel number or label, e.g. Parcel 1 or south meadow.

fields.label: UKHab habitat type
fields.voiceHint: State the UKHab type or best-fit habitat, e.g. modified grassland or native hedgerow.

fields.label: Distinctiveness band
fields.voiceHint: Note distinctiveness if known from metric lookup.

fields.label: Area
fields.voiceHint: Give the area in hectares, or length in kilometres for linear habitats.

fields.label: Area unit
fields.voiceHint: Hectares for polygons; kilometres for hedgerows and linear watercourses.

fields.label: Area measurement method
fields.voiceHint: How the area was derived.

fields.label: Condition criteria set
fields.voiceHint: Pick the criteria checklist that matches the habitat being assessed.

fields.label: Condition (overall)
fields.voiceHint: Call Good, Moderate, or Poor once criteria are assessed.

fields.label: Criteria assessment
fields.voiceHint: For each criterion, say pass or fail and the supporting evidence.

fields.label: Condition evidence summary
fields.voiceHint: Summarise the key evidence behind the condition call.

fields.label: Matches desk study?
fields.voiceHint: Say whether the on-site type matches the provisional desk-study type.

fields.label: Override reason
fields.voiceHint: If overriding the desk study, explain why with field evidence.

forms.title: PEA walkover notes
forms.description: Site context, access, designations, features, and recommendations.
forms.methodology: Preliminary Ecological Appraisal walkover — site-level context and feature notes to support baseline reporting.

fields.label: Weather
fields.voiceHint: Describe weather and conditions, e.g. overcast, dry, 12°C, light breeze.

fields.label: Temperature
fields.voiceHint: Approximate air temperature if relevant.

fields.label: Visibility / lighting
fields.voiceHint: Note anything affecting observation quality.

fields.label: Access and routes
fields.voiceHint: How you accessed the site, gates, paths, and any restrictions.

fields.label: Access constraints
fields.voiceHint: Livestock, crops, security, tidal windows, or areas not visited.

fields.label: Health and safety
fields.voiceHint: Hazards encountered or mitigation used on site.

fields.label: Statutory designations
fields.voiceHint: SSSI, SAC, SPA, Ramsar, NNR, or confirm none on or adjacent.

fields.label: Local / non-statutory designations
fields.voiceHint: LWS, local nature reserves, BNG strategic areas, etc.

fields.label: Priority habitats / BAP habitats
fields.voiceHint: Habitats of principal importance or local priority habitats present.

fields.label: Habitat mosaic summary
fields.voiceHint: Broad habitat types and how they are arranged across the site.

fields.label: Notable features
fields.voiceHint: Veteran trees, ponds, streams, scrub blocks, buildings, etc.

fields.label: Target notes
fields.voiceHint: Point observations tagged to a parcel or site level.

fields.label: Further survey needs
fields.voiceHint: Species or habitat surveys recommended from the walkover.

fields.label: Enhancement / mitigation opportunities
fields.voiceHint: BNG enhancement, habitat creation, or avoidance opportunities.

fields.label: Summary recommendations
fields.voiceHint: Overall PEA conclusions and next steps.

forms.title: Preliminary Roost Assessment - Bats
forms.description: Buildings, trees, roost features, suitability, and survey recommendations.
forms.methodology: CIEEM bat survey guidelines — preliminary roost assessment of buildings and trees for potential roost features (PRFs) and roost suitability.

sections.label: Structure
sections.description: Repeat for each building, structure, or tree assessed.

fields.label: Structure reference
fields.voiceHint: Label the structure, e.g. Barn A, Oak T1, or outbuilding north.

fields.label: Structure type
fields.voiceHint: Building, tree, bridge, or other roosting structure.

fields.label: Tree species
fields.voiceHint: For trees: species and approximate age class if known.

fields.label: Height class
fields.voiceHint: Approximate height band for trees or structures.

fields.label: PRFs present
fields.voiceHint: Say whether potential roost features were found.

fields.label: PRF types
fields.voiceHint: List PRF types: raised tiles, gaps, crevices, hollows, etc.

fields.label: PRF location on structure
fields.voiceHint: Where on the structure, e.g. north gable ridge, upper crown.

fields.label: Access to PRF
fields.voiceHint: Whether bats could access the feature.

fields.label: Signs of bats
fields.voiceHint: Droppings, urine stains, feeding remains, or live activity.

fields.label: Species indication
fields.voiceHint: Any indication of species from signs, if possible.

fields.label: Roost suitability
fields.voiceHint: Overall roost suitability based on PRFs and context.

fields.label: Constraints
fields.voiceHint: Lighting, disturbance, renovation risk, or access limits.

fields.label: Further survey recommendation
fields.voiceHint: Recommended follow-up survey if suitability is moderate or high.

fields.label: Recommendations
fields.voiceHint: Timing, methodology, and mitigation notes.

forms.title: Badger survey
forms.description: Setts, paths, latrines, foraging signs, and mitigation buffers.
forms.methodology: Standard badger survey — sett classification, activity signs, and buffer guidance per planning and protected species legislation.

fields.label: Sett reference
fields.voiceHint: Label the sett, e.g. Sett 1 or hedgebank east.

fields.label: Sett type
fields.voiceHint: Main, annex, subsidiary, outlier, or possible sett.

fields.label: Sett activity
fields.voiceHint: Fresh spoil, prints, or recent digging indicating activity.

fields.label: Entrance holes
fields.voiceHint: Approximate number of visible entrance holes.

fields.label: Sett location description
fields.voiceHint: Describe position relative to site features and proposed works.

fields.label: Badger paths
fields.voiceHint: Well-used paths through vegetation or fence lines.

fields.label: Path notes
fields.voiceHint: Where paths run and whether they link setts or foraging.

fields.label: Latrines
fields.voiceHint: Latrine pits or dung pits observed.

fields.label: Latrine notes
fields.voiceHint: Location and freshness of latrines.

fields.label: Foraging signs
fields.voiceHint: Snuffle holes, turned turf, or feeding remains.

fields.label: Hair snagging
fields.voiceHint: Hair on wire or fence at sett entrances.

fields.label: Prints / spoil
fields.voiceHint: Fresh spoil heaps, prints in mud, or other direct evidence.

fields.label: Recommended buffer (m)
fields.voiceHint: Stand-off distance from sett to proposed works if relevant.

fields.label: Disturbance risk
fields.voiceHint: Risk from proximity of works, lighting, or noise.

fields.label: Licence implications
fields.voiceHint: Whether EPS licence or method statement may be required.

fields.label: Recommendations
fields.voiceHint: Monitoring, timing restrictions, or further survey.

forms.title: Great Crested Newt HSI
forms.description: Pond suitability scoring for great crested newts.
forms.methodology: Great Crested Newt Habitat Suitability Index (HSI) — pond and landscape scoring per ARG/CICEEM guidance (10 parameters, 0–3 each).

fields.label: Pond reference
fields.voiceHint: Label the pond, e.g. Pond 1 or farm pond south.

fields.label: Grid reference
fields.voiceHint: OS grid reference for the pond.

fields.label: Water present ≥6 months?
fields.voiceHint: Whether the pond holds water for at least six months of the year.

sections.label: HSI parameters
sections.description: Score each parameter 0 (poor) to 3 (good). Total HSI = sum of scores.

fields.label: Pond area
fields.voiceHint: 0 = very small; 3 = large pond (>0.5 ha typically scores high).

fields.label: Pond permanence
fields.voiceHint: How long water persists through the year.

fields.label: Water quality
fields.voiceHint: Clarity, pollution, eutrophication, or algal blooms.

fields.label: Percentage shade
fields.voiceHint: 0 = heavily shaded; 3 = mostly open water.

fields.label: Water level disturbance
fields.voiceHint: Flood/drainage disturbance or stable levels.

fields.label: Fish abundance
fields.voiceHint: 0 = fish present; 3 = no fish (better for GCN).

fields.label: Waterfowl
fields.voiceHint: Geese, ducks, or other waterfowl using the pond.

fields.label: Aquatic macrophytes
fields.voiceHint: Submerged and floating aquatic plants.

fields.label: Pond cluster / connectivity
fields.voiceHint: Other ponds within 1 km — metapopulation context.

fields.label: Terrestrial habitat within 1 km
fields.voiceHint: Quality of woodland, grassland, and hedgerow in the landscape.

fields.label: Total HSI score
fields.voiceHint: Sum of parameter scores (max 30).

fields.label: HSI classification
fields.voiceHint: Overall pond suitability band from total score.

fields.label: GCN field evidence
fields.voiceHint: Eggs, larvae, adults, or eDNA results if available.

fields.label: Survey recommendation
fields.voiceHint: Follow-up survey if HSI or context warrants.

forms.title: Invasive non-native species survey
forms.description: Species, extent, location evidence, photos, and control recommendations.
forms.methodology: INNS survey — Schedule 9 (WCA 1981) species, extent mapping, and biosecurity / control recommendations.

fields.label: Species
fields.voiceHint: Scientific or common name, e.g. Japanese knotweed or Fallopia japonica.

fields.label: Schedule 9 species?
fields.voiceHint: Whether listed on Schedule 9 of the Wildlife and Countryside Act.

fields.label: Extent
fields.voiceHint: How widely the species occurs on site.

fields.label: Area affected
fields.voiceHint: Approximate area covered if mappable.

fields.label: Location
fields.voiceHint: Where on site relative to boundaries, access, and proposed works.

fields.label: Growth stage
fields.voiceHint: Stage affecting identification and control timing.

fields.label: Photo references
fields.voiceHint: Photo numbers or filenames captured on site.

fields.label: Evidence notes
fields.voiceHint: Diagnostic features confirming identification.

fields.label: Spread vectors
fields.voiceHint: Soil movement, waterways, machinery routes, or adjacent sources.

fields.label: Existing control
fields.voiceHint: Whether control is already in place on site.

fields.label: Recommended control method
fields.voiceHint: Herbicide, cutting, excavation, or specialist contractor.

fields.label: Biosecurity measures
fields.voiceHint: Keep off areas, clean down plant, root barriers, etc.

fields.label: Recommendations
fields.voiceHint: Management, monitoring, and reporting requirements.
